responsibility: Declares REAL-to-string conversion routines that return DynamicStrings in floating-point, engineering, and fixed-point forms. It is the single-precision counterpart of ConvStringLong and serves as a reusable formatting interface for real-number conversion and I/O modules in the gm2 ISO library.
same_name_distinction: This file declares the REAL string-formatting API only; the same-stem ConvStringReal.mod implements those routines and is the single-precision counterpart to ConvStringLong rather than the long-real version.
